reuse.why: Does not extend the shared getDateWithWeekendRule that every weekend-handling path uses; instead writes a separate skip loop inside getNextDate.

duplication.why: The inline loop re-runs the occurrence lookup and re-checks isWeekend alongside the existing weekend rule, a second ad-hoc weekend decision next to the shared one.

placement.why: The daily-frequency rule is a special case wedged into getNextDate rather than in the weekend-rule function (or an occurrence-level helper) used by getUpcomingDates and schedule-template.

scope.why: Touches only getNextDate and its tests.

maintainability.why: A hard-coded two-iteration loop and a frequency check buried in getNextDate leave the weekend rule defined in two places that already disagree for daily schedules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts implements daily weekend skipping itself instead of through getDateWithWeekendRule; getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithWeekendRule and keep moving daily weekend occurrences.

disguised_duplication.where: The weekend decision (isWeekend + skipWeekend flag) is re-expressed as a skip loop in getNextDate parallel to getDateWithWeekendRule.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate skips; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and the schedule-template.ts date loop apply getDateWithWeekendRule directly and still move daily occurrences.
